task.description:
Run the EE-10 test suite and produce a test report.
1. Run zig build — capture output, verify exit 0.
2. Run zig build test — capture output, verify TC-EE-10-* unit tests (engine_test.zig) pass.
3. If BPM_TEST_DB_URL is set, run zig build test-integration — capture output, verify TC-EE-10-01 through TC-EE-10-06 pass.
4. Write test report to tests/reports/EE-10-test-run.json per test guide §8 format.
5. If all pass: result.status = PASS. If any fail: result.status = FAIL with issues list.
Complete the handoff when done.
acceptance_criteria: All EE-10 unit tests pass (engine_test.zig TC-EE-10-* variants)

result.summary: zig build exits 0. zig build test exits 0 with 100/189 tests passing (89 integration tests skip without BPM_TEST_DB_URL). All 15 engine unit tests in engine_test.zig pass including all 12 EE-10-specific unit tests (error set variants, struct layout, error-mapping correctness). A BLOCKER was found and fixed: engine_test.zig used relative @import paths that escaped the Zig 0.16 module root — fixed by switching to named bpm module imports and updating build.zig. Integration tests TC-EE-10-01 through TC-EE-10-06 are properly implemented in tests/integration/instance_error_test.zig but skip without BPM_TEST_DB_URL. Per test guide directive T-1, skipped MUST-requirement tests do not advance EE-10 to TESTED status.

issues.description: TC-EE-10-01 through TC-EE-10-06 (integration layer, all EE-10 MUST tests) skipped — BPM_TEST_DB_URL not set. EE-10 cannot reach TESTED status until these 6 tests pass against a real database.
engine_test.zig used relative @import paths escaping the Zig 0.16 module root. Fixed in this run by switching to named bpm module imports and updating build.zig.

result.next_action: Provide BPM_TEST_DB_URL and re-run zig build test-integration to execute TC-EE-10-01 through TC-EE-10-06. All unit tests pass; only integration DB tests remain. Route to RELEASE-VALIDATOR after integration tests confirm PASS, or route back to ORCH to provision a test DB environment.
